# ADR-XXXX — Decision title

Date: YYYY-MM-DD · Status: Proposed / Accepted / Superseded · Owners: named technical+clinical/legal approver when relevant

## Context & evidence
Which user problem, regulation version, clinical or technical issue motivates this decision? Official source URL/hash if legal. What is unknown?

## Alternatives
A) ... B) ... C) ... Compare data correctness, cost, privacy, migration, integration and safety.

## Decision
Chosen solution, scope and explicit out-of-scope; clear invariants, schema contracts and failure behavior.

## Consequences

## Verification
Tests, benchmarks, signed regulatory mapping, source, commit, date reviewed. Do not write 'approved' without human evidence.
